title: Mechanistic Interpretability Circuit Atlas
description: A living collection of small-network circuit studies for algorithmic tasks: hand-built reference networks, partly trained and from-scratch transformers, and external recurrent-model zoo snapshots. Entries report task performance separately from substitution and complement-resampling evidence, and keep failures, limited coverage and unresolved mechanisms. This archive holds the atlas text, figures and code; the networks and training snapshots are archived on Hugging Face at the revisions named in the release notes.
